_comment: Every key is optional. Delete the ones you do not need - the defaults below are what the skill uses when a key is missing. Any key can also be overridden for one run with an ORCH_<KEY> environment variable, e.g. ORCH_DEFAULT_CWD.
_default_cwd: the directory new sessions start in, and the project whose logs the board reads. Default: the current directory.
_session_prefix: how Claude Code names sessions here, without the -xx suffix. Default: the lowercased basename of default_cwd.
_orchestrator_tab: the herdr tab label the orchestrator sits in. Default: orchestrator.
_accounts_tool: optional script that prints an OAuth token for a named account: <tool> token <name>. Leave empty and account switching is off - every pane uses the ambient login.
_cdp_url: optional DevTools URL of the one shared Chrome that sessions drive (the browser lock guards it). `doctor` probes <cdp_url>/json/version when set. Default: empty, no probe.
_rotate_at_k: context size in thousands of tokens at which a session is marked for rotation. Default: 400.
_projects_dir: where Claude Code keeps session logs. Default: ~/.claude/projects.
_handoffs_dir: where handoff and task files are written. Default: ~/.claude/handoffs.
_board_dir: where the board's state and generated page live. Default: <skill>/board.
_digest_repos: repos `board.py digest` reads this morning's commits from. Default: none.
